blockers.finding: Static precloud proposal and Oct10 local/emulator screenshots are presented as a current cloud demonstration; final links remain visibly pending.

PR6 notice is a deterministic template rendered client-side with Copy Draft; no notification/email dispatch or extra AI generation call exists.
No measured 48h baseline or realized ROI; 3 sub15s sample workflows do not establish an SLA or 100% auditability; no verified USD40 monthly spending cap.

Precloud/draft/pending labels remain; actual final public video URL absent; provenance should describe fresh AI Studio Build origin, Gemini and teammate-confirmed Antigravity cloud-deployment assistance.
Audio listening, actual spoken-word synchronization and final public browser playback NOT_RUN; generator trims all speech to scene target duration.
